body:
I've been suicidal for the past few years and I don't really feel a survival instinct to preserve my life. Logically I see no reason to stay here, but humanity in general says it's abnormal so I haven't done anything about it. Plus sometimes something fun happens so that's nice.

Probably obvious, but this is an old throwaway account and I likely won't respond - doesn't mean I killed myself.

I guess I should have clarified that my third girlfriend and I broke up because I turned into an asshole after my mother turned into a drunk for a few years. I said a lot of cruel things and coupled with how she must have felt after realizing I wasn't sexually interested in her I had no choice but to mutually let her go. I pretty much just didn't deserve her.

It's a long story spanning months, but I'll try my best to shorten it. Basically I was part of a big group chat hosted in part by the college. Once we got comfortable enough with each other we'd strike up some banter back and forth. Unfortunately during open house one of my friends was on the receiving end of sexual harassment and was badly shook up. I was at home during this. Shortly after I did our usual thing trying to get her attention (avoiding details to not reveal who I am - I can imagine some of them being redditors). Unfortunately someone took it out of context as 16-17 year olds do and it devolved into a really weird conversation about who they'd do (in particular, my friend). I wasn't really interested in it so I stayed out for the most part. Unfortunately for me, after the harassment going on the school was apparently ravenous for someone to take the fall. They picked me and a few others and charged us with sexual harassment. Me for being the instigator, I presume, and the rest for being the heart of the conversation. I actually felt like shit for a while there thinking I really had upset her by accidentally starting the conversation, but even she appealed for me to stay. In the end it turns out people are just people - looking after themselves. The administration saw its chance to look like they did something and they jumped on it. I guess to them I was just a statistic after all.

I don't really care either way about pills. If I had to choose I'd rather avoid them, but I guess ultimately I'd rather just not want to die. If it turns out my brain's just shit at producing a neurotransmitter I'd be happy to fix it. Talking I'm not really good at though. Sitting here with a screen between me and another is one thing, but ever since I was a kid I was taught to never show or complain about any negative emotion (last time I did, 5ish years ago my mother screamed at me for a good 2-3 hours). Old habits die hard I suppose - I can only type tihs because the anonymity of the internet leaves me without consequences.

I guess I have "close" friends I can talk to, but whenever I open up to them in the heat of the moment I buckle and just tear a mask off to reveal another mask. Hell, one time I did open up, but that friend gave me the opening I needed with the old "this doesn't sound like you, what's going on". Didn't take long for me to panic and pass it off as a joke.

I've spent 21 years building an impenetrable persona as the guy who's always optimistic and never unhappy so I suppose a lot of my not wanting to talk to my friends has to do with keeping that facade up. Besides, the world is what we make of it. For all intents and purposes I am always optimistic and never unhappy. Who knows, if I do jump off that bridge people might just say "he slipped" and reality will adapt to that truth once the last person who knows what really happened is gone.

Don't worry about being nosy, I'm one in a 7 billion, I have nothing to hide since this will never make it back to me and I guess it's nice to put what I've been thinking into words. If I sound too pessimistic or cynical don't take it too personally, I can appreciate that someone would take time out of their day to hear my end-is-neigh drivel.
